kamloops.title: Meadow Valley resident stayed to save his home from wildfire: ‘This is my life’
kamloops.description: The Bald Range wildfire broke out near Summerland last Friday evening. Meadow Valley resident Tyler Wall said he knew he wasn't going to leave his home and business.

kamloops.title: Child dies after being hit by car at Abbotsford townhouse complex
kamloops.description: Anyone who witnessed the collision or who may have dash camera footage of the incident is asked to contact the Abbotsford Police Department at 604-859-5225.

kamloops.title: Penticton search and rescue members helped others evacuate as their homes burned
kamloops.description: Other search and rescue teams also responded to calls for help, including Princeton, Central Okanagan, Oliver, Osoyoos, Rossland and Grand Forks.

kamloops.title: Status of ‘iconic’ mountain goats living near evacuated B.C. community is uncertain
kamloops.description: It is not clear yet what has happened to a small group of "iconic"  mountain goats, as a large wildfire burns out of control near the evacuated community of Summerland, B.C.

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 13
kamloops.description: Highway 97, which has been closed due to the wildfire between Peachland and the Pyramid Picnic Area in Kickininee Provincial Park, has reopened with limited hours, according to  DriveBC on Thursday .

kamloops.title: Wildfire near Summerland threatens mountain goats living on nearby cliffs
kamloops.description: The B.C. government says a small herd of mountain goats are "thought to have escaped" the large wildfire that burns out of control near the evacuated community of Summerland.

kamloops.title: All-party committee, including 3 NDP MLAs, calls for government to scrap PST expansion
kamloops.description: May small businesses are not happy about the NDP government's plan to expand the provincial sales tax to a range of professional services in October. An all-party finance committee, which includes NDP MLAs, recommends that the government scrap the expansion. The B.C. Conservatives say it shows NDP backbenchers are at odds with the Finance Minister.

kamloops.title: Members of Okanagan Indian Band mourn loss of forests and irreplaceable artifacts in wildfire
kamloops.description: More than just homes have been destroyed by the Bradley Creek Wildfire. The Okanagan Indian Band Indigenous community has also lost irreplaceable artifacts and forests where their great-grandparents picked berries.

kamloops.title: Okanagan wildfires hurting tourism in B.C. towns hundreds of kilometres away
kamloops.description: Wildfires burning hundreds of kilometres away are affecting tourism in B.C.’s Columbia Valley, with some visitors cancelling or reconsidering trips. Local tourism officials say the region remains open and largely unaffected by the fires themselves.

prince-george.title: Tending the animals trapped by B.C. wildfires: 'You can see their whole spirit change'
prince-george.description: On Tuesday, Agriculture Minister Lana Popham said up to 50,000 agricultural animals were under threat from wildfires.

cariboo.title: Fort St. James ER hours cut until at least October amid doctor shortage
cariboo.description: Northern Health is reducing emergency department hours at Nats’oojeh Hospital in Fort St. James because of a shortage of physicians, with the changes expected to continue until at least October.
